lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows. The centroids are most distinct in the posterior section relative to the gills, with a higher spatial density and smaller diameter observed moving towards the anterior/gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like topology where the high-intensity blobs act as nodes within the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible across the upper-mid flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance values along the top edge and distinct shadowing immediately beneath it, defining a structural ridge.
